Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unsupported assumption that there might be another “Bubblegum Alley” in San Diego’s Gaslamp Quarter and even instructed the WebSurfer to infer approximate coordinates if none were found. This speculative direction contradicted the authoritative sources already confirming the correct location in downtown San Luis Obispo (733 Higuera St) and risked leading to an incorrect solution by diverting from verified information.
